decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until full details of landscape work including planting plans, written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment), shedule of plants, oting species, proposed numbers/densities where appropriate and implemetation programme, have been dubmitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.
Condition : 4 - Trees should be protected from any damge during the construction of the brick boundary wall on the south west side of Sandalwood Road.
Condition : 5 - The existing car parking bays on the eastern side of the Pinewood Road, should be bordered by bollards or a low rail to the written satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Enviromental & security improvements incorporating security entrance doors, alterations to car parking layout, fencing, wall & gates and erection of 4 garages and landscaping improvements to existing childrens play area
